headline: Social Welfare Assistant, RSW
summary: Registered social worker with a year of casework at a family welfare foundation in Ilocos Sur. I meet families in crisis, write intake and case notes, give counselling support, and connect clients with the services and people who can help them. I build trust quickly with parents and children.
skills: Case documentation: intake, case notes, social case study reports
Counselling support for families and children
Talking with clients in Ilocano, Filipino and English

experience.title: Social Welfare Assistant
bullets: Handle a caseload of about 35 families facing poverty, abuse or abandonment.
Conduct intake interviews and home visits and write social case study reports within a week.
Give counselling support to parents and children and follow up every two weeks.
Refer families to health, legal aid and livelihood programs and track whether help arrived.

experience.title: Social Work Field Practicum Student
bullets: Assisted house parents and wrote progress notes for twelve children in residential care.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Social Work
